Documented values agree with source defaults: port 3000 (bin/speclang:175 `.option('-p, --port <port>', 'Dashboard port', '3000')`; `node bin/speclang start --help` and `daemon start --help` both print `(default: "3000")`); pid .speclang/daemon.pid (src/daemon/index.ts:50 `const pidFile = path.join(speclangDir, 'daemon.pid')`); log .speclang/daemon.log (src/daemon/config.ts:35 `file: '.speclang/daemon.log'`, and the doc correctly notes nothing writes it). REAL_EXIT=1 (doc §1 quotes exactly this, EXIT=1); `daemon status` -> '🔴 Daemon: Stopped', `--json` -> {"running":false,"pid":null,"status":"stopped"}; `status -d .` -> 'Daemon: Not running / Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl) / Generated files: 4'; `stop` and `daemon stop` -> 'Daemon not running'; `daemon status --help` shows only `--json` and `daemon stop --help` shows no options (doc §4 asymmetry #2 confirmed); `daemon start --help` shows -p/--port, -d/--dir, --dashboard, --no-cascade (doc §1 table matches); bin/speclang:480 prints 'Dashboard: not served by `daemon start` (use `speclang start`)' as quoted; src/daemon/index.ts:133 `app.listen(port, ...)` ignores the error arg (doc §6.2 mechanism claim correct) and /health returns {status:'ok',pid:process.pid} at index.ts:89-91; bin/speclang:58-69 corruptStateDatabaseMessage matches doc §6.5 verbatim with status exiting 1 on SQLITE_NOTADB (bin/speclang:332-339); .gitignore:38 is `.speclang/` as cited. Tests: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` -> 'Test Files 113 passed | 4 skipped (117) / Tests 1949 passed | 58 skipped (2007)'; targeted `npx vitest run tests/daemon/pid-file-enoent.test.ts tests/db/corrupt-state-db.test.ts` -> 'Tests 16 passed (16)'. One minor inaccuracy noted (not a criterion failure): doc §2 says `.speclang/daemon-state.json` is 'written by the daemon on start', but Daemon.start() only calls state.load() (src/daemon/daemon.ts:128) and never save(); state is persisted only via State.setStatus->save() (src/daemon/state.ts:91-94) and Daemon.stop() (daemon.ts:151), so on a fresh project dir the file does not exist until shutdown and `speclang daemon status` prints 'Status: unknown'.
